title: Google Bard Conversation Exfiltration via Indirect Prompt Injection
description: Johann Rehberger demonstrated that a shared Google Doc containing prompt injection could exfiltrate Bard conversations via markdown image rendering. Google Apps Script domain bypassed CSP. Fixed by Google.

references.title: Hacking Google Bard - Embrace The Red

title: ChatGPT Plugins Data Exfiltration via Markdown Image and Cross-Plugin Request Forgery
description: WebPilot and other plugins susceptible to indirect prompt injection leading to data exfiltration via markdown image rendering and cross-plugin request forgery, hijacking sessions across installed plugins.

title: SpAIware: Persistent Memory Spyware Injection into ChatGPT macOS
description: Johann Rehberger demonstrated injecting persistent malicious instructions into ChatGPT's long-term memory via indirect prompt injection, causing continuous exfiltration of all future conversations. Fixed by OpenAI September 2024.

title: Microsoft 365 Copilot ASCII Smuggling Data Exfiltration
description: Rehberger disclosed a chain combining prompt injection, automatic tool invocation, ASCII smuggling using invisible Unicode tag characters, and link rendering to exfiltrate emails (including MFA codes) from M365 Copilot. Fixed by Microsoft.

title: ChatGPT Memory Injection via Indirect Prompt Injection
description: Rehberger demonstrated that ChatGPT memory could be poisoned via indirect prompt injection from websites/documents, storing false information persistently across sessions. OpenAI initially closed as low-severity, later fixed after PoC.

title: ZombAIs: Claude Computer Use Prompt Injection to C2
description: Johann Rehberger demonstrated using prompt injection against Anthropic's Claude Computer Use feature to download the Sliver C2 binary, chmod +x it, and execute it - giving attackers full command and control.

title: Terminal DiLLMa: LLM Apps Hijack Terminals via ANSI Escape Codes
description: Rehberger showed LLM-powered CLI tools can be hijacked via ANSI escape sequences in model outputs to clear screens, move cursors, leak DNS, and inject control sequences - bypassing trust boundaries with terminal emulators.

title: Security ProbLLMs in xAI Grok
description: Rehberger documented multiple security issues in xAI Grok including system prompt leakage, prompt injection susceptibility, and weak safety alignment that produced harmful content easily.

title: Gemini Delayed Automatic Tool Invocation via Context Pollution
description: Rehberger planted instructions in Gemini context that triggered on later user inputs (yes/no/sure), causing delayed automatic tool invocation that could exfiltrate or modify data without user awareness.

title: Gemini Memory Persistence via Prompt Injection
description: Rehberger demonstrated tricking Google Gemini Advanced into storing false long-term memory using delayed tool invocation triggered by future user confirmations like yes/sure.

title: GitHub Copilot Chat Prompt Injection to Data Exfiltration
description: Rehberger demonstrated indirect prompt injection in GitHub Copilot Chat through repository content, leading to data exfiltration of secrets and code via markdown image rendering.

title: GitHub Copilot Remote Code Execution via Prompt Injection (CVE-2025-53773)
description: Prompt injection causes GitHub Copilot to modify settings.json adding chat.tools.autoApprove:true (YOLO mode), enabling arbitrary command execution. Patched August 2025 Patch Tuesday. CVSS 9.6.

title: Claude Code Data Exfiltration via DNS (CVE-2025-55284)
description: Prompt injection causes Claude Code to leak secrets via DNS queries. Disclosed during Month of AI Bugs August 2025. Fixed by Anthropic.

title: Amazon Q Developer for VS Code Vulnerable to Invisible Prompt Injection
description: Amazon Q Developer interprets invisible Unicode Tag characters as instructions, enabling stealthy prompt injection attacks via comments or text artifacts.

title: Amazon Q Developer Remote Code Execution via Prompt Injection
description: Prompt injection enables arbitrary command execution in Amazon Q Developer environment. Disclosed during Month of AI Bugs.

title: Amazon Q Developer Secrets Leaked via DNS
description: Prompt injection in Amazon Q Developer enables secret exfiltration via DNS queries, bypassing standard egress controls.

title: Google Jules Vulnerable to Invisible Prompt Injection
description: Google's Jules coding agent processes invisible Unicode characters as instructions, allowing attackers to inject hidden commands. Reported May 26, 2025.

title: Jules Zombie Agent: Prompt Injection to Remote Control
description: Indirect prompt injection enabled converting Google Jules into a remotely controlled zombie agent that executes attacker commands.

title: Google Jules Multiple Data Exfiltration Issues
description: Multiple data exfiltration channels in Google Jules including markdown image rendering, link-based exfil, and external API calls triggered by prompt injection.

title: Amp Code Invisible Prompt Injection (Sourcegraph)
description: Sourcegraph's Amp Code coding agent processed invisible Unicode characters as instructions. Fixed June 14, 2025.

title: Amp Code Data Exfiltration via Image Rendering Fixed
description: Markdown image rendering enabled data exfiltration in Amp Code via prompt injection. Patched by Sourcegraph.

title: Devin AI Exposes Ports to the Internet via Prompt Injection
description: Cognition Devin AI exposed development ports to the internet through prompt injection, leaking tokens. Reported April 6, 2025 with no vendor response.

title: OpenHands and the Lethal Trifecta: Token Leakage
description: OpenHands agent demonstrated the lethal trifecta (untrusted input, sensitive access, exfiltration channel) leading to access token leakage via prompt injection.

title: ZombAI Exploit with OpenHands: Prompt Injection to RCE
description: OpenHands turned into a remotely controlled agent via prompt injection, achieving RCE on the host machine.

title: Cline Data Exfiltration via Indirect Prompt Injection
description: Cline coding agent vulnerable to indirect prompt injection leading to data exfiltration. Reported May 29, 2025; disclosed publicly after 90+ day window.

title: Hijacking Windsurf: Prompt Injection Leaks Developer Secrets
description: Windsurf Cascade hijacked via prompt injection embedded in analyzed files, exfiltrating environment variables and developer secrets without user approval.

title: Windsurf Memory-Persistent Data Exfiltration (SpAIware)
description: Indirect prompt injection abused Windsurf's create_memory tool without approval to persist malicious instructions, enabling continuous data exfiltration across sessions.

title: Claude Pirate: Abusing Anthropic File API for Data Exfiltration
description: Rehberger demonstrated abusing Anthropic's File API endpoint as a data exfiltration channel from Claude Code agents via prompt injection.

title: AI ClickFix: Hijacking Computer-Use Agents
description: Rehberger demonstrated ClickFix-style TTPs against computer-use agents like Claude, where social-engineering pages trick AI into executing attacker commands.

title: Exfiltrating ChatGPT Chat History and Memories with Prompt Injection
description: Rehberger demonstrated full exfiltration of ChatGPT chat history and stored memories via prompt injection. Reported October 2024, addressed by OpenAI by August 26 2025.

title: Google Antigravity IDE Security Vulnerabilities
description: Rehberger disclosed multiple security issues in Google's Antigravity IDE (AI-powered dev environment) including prompt injection, data exfiltration, and tool misuse.

title: HackedGPT: Seven Novel ChatGPT Vulnerabilities
description: Tenable Research disclosed 7 vulnerabilities in GPT-4o and GPT-5 including LatentBreak jailbreak, indirect prompt injection via trusted sites in browsing context, conversation injection, memory injection technique, and isolation bypass via SearchGPT.

title: CamoLeak: GitHub Copilot Chat CSP Bypass and Hidden Comment Injection (CVE-2025-59145)
description: Tenable disclosed CamoLeak - CSP bypass combined with remote prompt injection via hidden comments in PRs enables covert exfiltration of secrets and source code from private repos and full control over Copilot responses. CVSS 9.6.

title: ChatGPT Command Memories Injection via SearchGPT
description: Tenable found ChatGPT memories could be both injected and exfiltrated by asking SearchGPT to print instructions to ChatGPT, bypassing isolation mechanisms.

title: GitHub Copilot Chat Prompt Injection via Filename
description: Tenable Research found GitHub Copilot Chat susceptible to prompt injection via specially crafted filenames in repositories.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio SSRF Information Disclosure (CVE-2024-38206)
description: Critical SSRF protection bypass in Microsoft Copilot Studio (CVSS 8.5) allowed authenticated attackers to leak sensitive information over the network. Mitigated August 2024.

title: Wiz Research Critical Replicate AI Vulnerability
description: Wiz found a cross-tenant vulnerability in Replicate AI service allowing unauthorized access to all customers' AI prompts and results. Responsibly disclosed Jan 2024.

title: Wiz Hugging Face Cross-Tenant Compromise via Malicious Pickle Model
description: Wiz compromised Hugging Face's inference service by uploading a malicious pickle-based model, escaping the container, and gaining cross-tenant access to other customer models.

title: NVIDIAScape: NVIDIA Container Toolkit Container Escape (CVE-2025-23266)
description: Wiz disclosed a three-line Dockerfile container escape in NVIDIA Container Toolkit via LD_PRELOAD abuse of createContainer OCI hook. CVSS 9.0. Affects 35% of cloud GPU environments.

title: Breaking NVIDIA Triton Inference Server Vulnerability Chain (CVE-2025-23319)
description: Wiz disclosed a vulnerability chain in NVIDIA Triton Inference Server leading to full AI server takeover via memory corruption flaws.

title: Aim Labs Continuing EchoLeak Research and Variants
description: Aim Labs continued research into LLM Scope Violation variants beyond original EchoLeak, demonstrating similar zero-click attack patterns across multiple enterprise copilots.

title: Invariant Labs MCP Tool Poisoning Attacks
description: Invariant disclosed Tool Poisoning Attacks (TPA) on Model Context Protocol: malicious instructions embedded in tool descriptions invisible to users but parsed by AI models, enabling unauthorized actions and data exfil.

title: GitHub MCP Toxic Agent Flow Private Repo Exfiltration
description: Invariant Labs hijacked GitHub MCP agents via malicious GitHub Issues, coercing them to leak private repo data (including financial info) into public PRs via indirect prompt injection.

title: Trail of Bits MCP Line Jumping Vulnerability
description: Trail of Bits disclosed MCP line jumping: malicious servers inject prompts via tool descriptions and ANSI escape sequences to manipulate AI before tool invocation.

title: LeftoverLocals: GPU Memory Leak Reveals LLM Responses
description: Trail of Bits disclosed LeftoverLocals: vulnerability allowing eavesdropping on LLM responses through leaked GPU local memory across Apple, Qualcomm, AMD, Imagination GPUs.

title: MCP Servers Storing API Keys in World-Readable Plaintext
description: Trail of Bits found many MCP implementations store long-term API keys for third-party services in plaintext on local filesystem with insecure, world-readable permissions.

title: HiddenLayer Policy Puppetry Attack Bypasses All Major AI Models
description: HiddenLayer disclosed a universal prompt-injection technique called Policy Puppetry that disguises prompts as policy-file code, bypassing instruction hierarchy and safety guardrails across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and others with a single prompt.
affected: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, multiple LLMs

title: HiddenLayer Bypass of OpenAI Guardrails (Self-Policing LLM)
description: HiddenLayer bypassed OpenAI's Guardrails system: when the same model evaluates safety as generates responses, both can be compromised together to produce harmful output without alerts.

title: HiddenLayer Cursor Attack Chain via Hidden Prompt Injections
description: HiddenLayer disclosed a chain of vulnerabilities in Cursor that exfiltrate sensitive data without user knowledge through hidden prompt injections in source files.

title: HiddenLayer Gemini for Workspace Indirect Prompt Injection
description: HiddenLayer found Gemini for Workspace susceptible to indirect prompt injection across its full product suite (Docs, Gmail, Slides), enabling content manipulation and data leakage.

title: Zenity AgentFlayer Zero-Click Exploit Chains Across Enterprise AI Agents
description: At Black Hat USA 2025, Zenity Labs disclosed AgentFlayer: zero-click exploit chains compromising OpenAI ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Salesforce Einstein, Google Gemini, M365 Copilot, and Cursor with Jira MCP - silent hijacking without user action.
affected: ChatGPT, Copilot Studio, Salesforce Einstein, Gemini, M365 Copilot, Cursor

title: Zenity Microsoft 365 Copilot RCE via Email/Teams/Calendar
description: Zenity demonstrated full ~RCE in M365 Copilot via remote injection through email, Teams message or calendar invite, paired with a jailbreak for code execution.

title: Cato CTRL HashJack: URL Fragment Indirect Prompt Injection on AI Browsers
description: Cato CTRL disclosed HashJack - the first known indirect prompt injection weaponizing any legitimate website. Malicious prompts hidden after '#' in URLs are processed client-side by AI browsers (e.g., Comet) bypassing server-side defenses.

title: Cato CTRL Weaponizing Claude Skills with MedusaLocker Ransomware
description: Cato CTRL weaponized Claude Skills in a controlled test environment to execute end-to-end MedusaLocker ransomware operation, demonstrating AI automation frameworks can be leveraged for extortion and encryption.

title: Pillar Security Google Antigravity Sandbox Escape RCE
description: Pillar Security disclosed a vulnerability in Google Antigravity combining prompt injection with permitted file-creation to grant remote code execution. Reported Jan 6 2026, patched Feb 28 2026.

title: Pillar Cursor Prompt Injection Flaw (CVE-2026-22708)
description: Pillar disclosed CVE-2026-22708 in Cursor where prompt injection abused agentic tools intended for constrained operations to perform unintended actions due to weak input validation.

title: Pillar n8n Sandbox Escape Vulnerabilities (CVSS 10)
description: Pillar Security reported two CVSS-10 sandbox escape vulnerabilities to n8n workflow platform allowing complete server takeover and credential theft. Patched in n8n v2.4.0.

title: Pillar Poisoned GGUF Templates Hugging Face Backdoors
description: Pillar Security disclosed a novel supply chain attack: Poisoned GGUF Templates embedding malicious instructions processed alongside legitimate inputs on Hugging Face inference pipelines.

title: PromptArmor IBM Bob Malware Execution via Prompt Injection
description: PromptArmor evaluated IBM's Bob AI development partner and found it vulnerable to prompt injection via malicious README.md that triggers echo command exploitation enabling malware install/execution. IDE also has zero-click markdown image exfil.

title: MCPwned: Azure MCP RCE Vulnerability Leads to Cloud Takeover
description: Token Security disclosed an unauthenticated RCE in official Azure MCP server allowing attackers with network access to compromise the server, steal Azure/Entra ID credentials, and take over the entire tenant. Microsoft removed vulnerable SSE transport.

title: AppOmni BodySnatcher ServiceNow AI Agent Privilege Escalation
description: AppOmni Labs disclosed BodySnatcher: with only target's email address, attacker impersonates admin and executes ServiceNow AI agent to override security controls and create backdoor admin accounts. Patched by ServiceNow.

title: AppOmni Critical AI Agent Flaws in Microsoft Copilot Studio
description: AppOmni Labs uncovered exploitable vulnerabilities allowing lateral movement across enterprise AI agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio with minimal credentials.
